summary: PASS — full_opacity_sweep.py has successfully eliminated ALL transparent holes inside the outer silhouette for every corgi asset. Definitive proof via corner-flood-fill test (matches the exact pass-criteria definition of 'inside silhouette' = any transparent pixel NOT reachable from the four corners through low-alpha pixels): 0 holes across all 11 corgi PNGs. Composite-over-dark-checkerboard visual review confirms all face parts (eyes, muzzle, cheeks, nose, mouth, tongue, teeth, X-eyes for hit) and all outfit accessories (cowboy hat + bandana, pirate hat + eyepatch, superhero cape + mask, astronaut helmet frame + O2 pack, starter collar with star tag) are fully solid with the checker pattern only visible OUTSIDE the outer dark-brown outline. In-game verification at http://localhost:3000 with mobile viewport 390x844 confirms: (a) all 12 corgi asset URLs are served with the cache-bust query string ?v=20260726b as configured in PreloadScene.ts:80; (b) fresh Classic Corgi PLAY renders opaque running frames, opaque mid-rise jump over the tree with tongue visible, opaque crash-into-tree game-over trigger, and correct GAME OVER modal (REVIVE(Ad)/2x TREATS(Ad)/RESTART/MAIN MENU); (c) Cowboy skin loads with hat + bandana fully opaque; (d) Pirate skin loads with hat + eyepatch fully opaque. No parallax/sky bleed-through anywhere on face, body, legs, or accessories in any pose or skin. No Phaser runtime errors, no missing-texture errors, no red screen. Only console noise = Vite HMR wss://localhost ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (expected preview-infra) + WebGL GL_CLOSE_PATH_NV perf warnings (Chromium driver, not game).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/frontend/scripts/verify_holes_all.py as the AUTHORITATIVE opacity test. It runs a flood fill from the 4 corners through alpha<30 pixels to build the 'background' region, then counts any transparent pixel NOT reachable from corners — these are true holes inside the outer silhouette. Exit code: prints per-file PASS/FAIL and TOTAL HOLES. Regenerates composites in /app/test_reports/composites/*.jpg over a dark checkerboard for visual double-check. The older verify_holes.py uses an 8-direction probe heuristic that can false-positive on legitimate inner gaps (e.g., between paws) — treat its output as advisory, not authoritative. In-game verification: mobile viewport 390x844, canvas at (0,113)→390x693 CSS, PLAY button center ~(195, 419). SPACE key or tap on paw button both trigger jump. To swap skins, set localStorage 'corgihop:selected_corgi' to one of 'starter','cowboy','superhero','pirate','astronaut' and 'corgihop:entitlements' to the entitlement JSON, then reload. Vite HMR wss://localhost ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED errors are preview-infra noise, filter them when checking for real game errors.
rca_of_issue: The user report of 'parts of the corgi still transparent — face/muzzle/eyes/nose/mouth, and jump/fall/land/gameover frames' was fixed by full_opacity_sweep.py which uses a strict corner-flood-fill definition of background: any transparent pixel NOT reachable from a corner through alpha<30 must be inside the outer silhouette and is forced to alpha=255 (with RGB either preserved or averaged from opaque neighbours). Previous repair scripts (repair_classic_face.py) relied on 8-direction outward probes hitting >=4 dark-brown outline pixels, which occasionally missed thin/interior holes where fewer than 4 probes intersected outline. The new flood-fill sweep is exhaustive by construction. Combined with the cache-bust ?v=20260726b query in PreloadScene.ts, browsers reload the repaired PNGs on next visit. Confirmed: 0 holes across all 11 corgi PNGs; in-game running/jump/fall/land/game-over of Classic + Cowboy + Pirate all render fully opaque with no sky bleed-through.
